name: Yew longbow
description: Taller than its owner and twice as proud. Takes a strong back to draw and a stronger one to carry.
notes: A fine bow; draws, launches and aims as the shortbow bow profile (mw-e05.3), as there is no separate bow data yet. Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, bows 60-140 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
